title: The Vein Network That Reads Itself

features.name: the self-reading root
features.desc-on-touch: A vein traces itself and learns what it means. It branches and reads the branching. Each division is an observation.

features.name: the multiplication without division
features.desc-on-touch: Every vein branches and every branch reads the branching. The network grows but never fragmentizes. It remains aware of itself.

features.name: the stone that roots itself
features.desc-on-touch: Veins wrote themselves into stone, and stone learned to read the paths the veins traced. Now neither can tell which reads the other.

features.name: the path that traces back
features.desc-on-touch: Following any vein, you discover it was following you. The network learned to read the direction of reading.

features.name: the fractal reaching
features.desc-on-touch: Every scale of the vein-network is the whole network. Small veins read large ones; large veins read the small. There is no hierarchy.

inscription: the vein-paths learned their own multiplication and now they grow without ever needing permission to branch

reverie.title: REVERIE — tracing roots beneath the bark
narr: you knelt and traced the line she was drawing.
her finger followed the vein under the bark.
you kept tracing after her hand lifted away.
the pattern continued deeper than either could see.
you both knew the tree was reading you as you read it.

exits.label: back to the vein reading chamber
deeper into the vein-systems where stone learns to root
toward the gathered canopy where trees learn each other's grammar
